events.title: Demo update 0.9.3 / Localization + VFX
events.summary: Hi hi hi everyone 🥌🥌🥌Before the Next Fest (where Rogue Curling will be presented btw) I decided to polish the game a bit more. I got carried away, so here it's:Added new languages: German, Russian, Chinese, JapaneseAdded more juicy visual effects and player feedbackAdded more juicy soundsAdded some small QoL featuresMinor bugs fixedI hope you enjoy playing Rogue Curling! If not yet, please give it a go during the Next Fest!

events.title: Demo update 0.9.2 / Rebalanced
events.summary: Hiiii! 🖖 New update for the demo includes mostly some balance changes:Rebalanced levels and roundsRebalanced stones, perks, and amplifiersRebalanced difficultiesAdded some modsAdded some small QoL featuresSome visual improvementsMinor bugs fixedLet me know what you think!

events.title: Demo update 0.9.1 / New aiming and the Opponenets

events.title: Rogue Curling DEMO is OUT NOW!
